title: Swearing Off 'Toxic' AIPAC Money: Oregon Democrat Opens Up to Mehdi
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Just two years ago, AIPAC infiltrated the congressional race in Oregon,
spending roughly [$2 million](https://theintercept.com/2024/05/03/portland-
aipac-susheela-jayapal-maxine-dexter/) to elect Democratic Congresswoman and
physician **Maxine Dexter.**

Since then, you could say she's turned her back on the pro-Israel lobby. She's
taken a stand against Israel, co-sponsoring key legislation like the [Block
the Bombs Act](https://www.blockthebombs.org/) and the [Gaza Genocide
resolution](https://multdems.org/rep-dexter-denounces-war-crimes-in-gaza/).

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" Everything about that [AIPAC] money has been toxic,"** Dexter tells Mehdi,
**" It was a mistake."**

For the first time publicly, she's swearing off taking any future AIPAC money.
"**The Netanyahu government is clearly misguided. He 's a war criminal. What's
happening in Gaza is a genocide. I have no qualms about saying those things
out loud."**

But AIPAC isn't the only topic they discussed. In this wide-ranging interview,
Mehdi also presses Rep. Dexter on:

  * Whether the U.S. should fund defensive weapons to Israel

  * Her [Iran War Powers resolution](https://dexter.house.gov/media/press-releases/dexter-introduces-war-powers-resolution-end-iran-war)

  * Trump's [billion-dollar ballroom renovation](https://www.npr.org/2026/05/06/g-s1-120455/republicans-trump-ballroom-billion)

  * Whether she supports Hakeem Jeffries's leadership

  * Her latest oversight [visit](https://www.opb.org/article/2026/02/13/crespo-gonzalez-family-gresham-maxine-dexter/) to ICE detention facilities in Texas.
